_beschreibung: 1.10 slice 5 (plan E20): which sidechain key a compressor stage may listen to. ONE description, bound on both sides: the core loader (arr_key.h, generated schluessel_regeln.inc) and the project server (project/key_table.ts, U3) read the generated tables; both test suites iterate EVERY cell and EVERY case of this file. Generated by djk/contract/erzeuge_schluessel.py. A stage keyed by a source in a cell other than 'ja' is refused with the reason of the answer.

antworten.ja: the key is there in the block before the consumer needs it
antworten.spaet: sidechain_spaet: the source is computed after the consumer in the block order (tracks, group chains, group faders, returns, PM)
antworten.zyklus: sidechain_zyklus: the source depends on the consumer (its own output, a member keyed by its own group, a track cycle, the PM that sums every strip)
antworten.quelle: sidechain_quelle: the source is not available in the block of the arrangement

zyklus.grund: erz/4 is the input the arrangement output goes into

quelle.grund: host return paths are collected after arr_->block
host return paths are collected after arr_->block

faelle.name: eigener_post
faelle.beschreibung: A track keyed by its own post: the strip depends on itself.

faelle.name: zwei_spuren_zyklus
faelle.beschreibung: Track 1 keyed by track 2 post and track 2 by track 1 post.

faelle.name: kette_von_kanten
faelle.beschreibung: Track 1 keyed by track 2 post, track 2 by track 3 post: a chain of edges is not a cycle.

faelle.name: mitglied_eigene_gruppe_post
faelle.beschreibung: A member track keyed by the post of its own group: the group sums the member.

faelle.name: mitglied_eigene_gruppe_pre
faelle.beschreibung: A member track keyed by the pre of its own group: the group sum holds the member's own output.

faelle.name: spur_fremde_gruppe
faelle.beschreibung: A track keyed by a group it is not a member of: groups are computed after all tracks.

faelle.name: gruppe_eigene_pre
faelle.beschreibung: A group keyed by its own pre: its own strip.

faelle.name: gruppe_andere_pre
faelle.beschreibung: A group keyed by the pre of another group: the sums are copied before any group chain.

faelle.name: gruppe_andere_post
faelle.beschreibung: A group keyed by the post of another group: the group faders run after all group chains.

faelle.name: return_gruppe_ohne_mitglieder
faelle.beschreibung: A key group without members is a silent key, not an error.

faelle.name: pm_return_fehlt
faelle.beschreibung: A key return that is not in the project is a silent key, not an error.

faelle.name: return_return
faelle.beschreibung: A return keyed by another return: the returns are computed in one pass.

faelle.name: return_eigener_post
faelle.beschreibung: A return keyed by its own post.

faelle.name: pm_als_quelle
faelle.beschreibung: The PM as a key: every strip feeds the PM, so the key is the consumer's own output.

faelle.name: pm_von_gruppe
faelle.beschreibung: The PM keyed by a group post: the PM chain runs after every group and return.

faelle.name: spur_pre_als_schluessel
faelle.beschreibung: The track pre key has one writer, the row sc: the structural form is refused (loader only; the server normalises it to sc).
